2. Z-index shifts and postcard translates Y upwards out of envelope with spring physics
3. Postcard scales to centered spotlight and enables 3D flip trigger

pages.description: High-impact whimsical landing page with interactive hero, live flip card simulator, 3-step 'How It Works' (Design -> Seal & Send -> Envelope Opening), featured template gallery, and guest/instant try-now mode.
Branded dual Login/Register screen supporting Email+Password and Mocked One-Click Google Sign-In with instant session creation.
User's postal desk listing created postcards (Sent, Drafts), view recipient open statistics (opened time, recipient opened badge), copy shareable links, and quick-create button.

Full-featured studio editor: Upload own photo OR choose curated whimsical templates, select Orientation (Landscape/Portrait) and Size (Standard 6x4, Large 7x5, Square), write rich heartfelt message, choose stamp design, select wax seal color, live 3D front/back flip canvas, and one-click 'Seal & Generate Postcard' modal.

Theatrical recipient experience at `/p/:id` or `/p/preview`. Renders paper envelope with personalized wax seal. Clicking wax seal runs flap-unfolding animation, pulls postcard upward out of envelope, activates 3D flip card with sound/visual delight (confetti / sparkle micro-particles), displays sender note, stamp, postmark stamp, and allows reply or making their own postcard.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup CSS fonts in `frontend/src/index.css`: import '@fontsource-variable/lora', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono'. Update `@theme inline` aliases for `--font-sans`, `--font-heading`, `--font-mono`.

2. Implement backend models and routes in FastAPI (`backend/server.py` or `backend/routers/postcards.py`): Postcard model (id, title, sender_name, recipient_name, recipient_email, orientation, size, front_image_url, message, stamp_id, wax_seal_color, date_str, is_draft, opened_count, opened_at, created_at, owner_id). Auth routes for login/register + Google mock login.
3. Seed default whimsical postcards and templates into Mongo via `backend/seed.py` so the dashboard and gallery immediately feel inhabited and magical.

4. Postcard Flip 3D: Use Tailwind utility classes for 3D flip (`perspective-[1200px]`, `transform-style-3d`, `rotate-y-180`, `backface-hidden`). Provide a visible button ('Flip to Back / Flip to Front') alongside clicking the card directly.

5. Recipient Envelope Opening flow: Stage 0 (Closed envelope with wax seal 'Tap to Open') -> Stage 1 (Wax seal snaps, envelope top flap flips upward) -> Stage 2 (Postcard slides up smoothly from inside pocket) -> Stage 3 (Postcard expands to full spotlight, prompt says 'Click card to flip'). When opened on `/p/:id`, call `POST /api/postcards/:id/open` to record opened time for sender tracking.
6. Free & No Payment friction: Postcards are generated instantly with a unique share URL `/p/<unique-id>`. Provide quick actions to Copy Link, Share via WhatsApp, or Preview as Recipient.
7. Mocking Highlight: Highlight that Google OAuth sign-in is MOCKED with realistic user profiles ('Alex Rivera', 'Jane Doe') for instant testing without requiring external Google API credentials.

8. Testing attributes: Ensure all buttons, links, inputs, stamps, and flip triggers have `data-testid` (e.g. `data-testid='flip-card-button'`, `data-testid='wax-seal-button'`, `data-testid='create-postcard-btn'`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No generic AI-slop layout: Use warm paper tones (#FAF7F2, #FFFDF9), tactile shadows, perforated edges, and vintage typography.
Every button and interaction must have responsive feedback, hover lift, active press states, and sound/visual polish.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to make postcard creating feel relaxing and artisanal.
Do not use transparent dropdown or modal backgrounds — ensure solid opaque glass or warm cream backgrounds with borders.
